parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  run_id: $json.run_id,
  config_id: $json.config_id || 101,
  user_id: $json.user_id || 5,
  prompt: $json.prompt,
  prompt_text: $json.prompt_text || $json.prompt,
  provider: $json.provider,
  model: $json.model,
  model_name: $json.model_name || $json.model,
  eu_hosted: Boolean($json.eu_hosted),
  search_enabled: Boolean($json.search_enabled),
  status: $json.status || 'completed',
  error_message: $json.error_message || null,
  cost_credits: $json.cost_credits !== undefined ? $json.cost_credits : ($json.status === 'failed' ? 0 : 1),
  brand_name: $json.brand_name,
  brand_mentioned: $json.brand_mentioned,
  brand_recommended: $json.brand_recommended,
  brand_prominence_rank: $json.brand_prominence_rank,
  char_earliness: $json.char_earliness,
  word_earliness: $json.word_earliness,
  relative_position_pct: $json.relative_position_pct,
  total_chars: $json.total_chars,
  total_words: $json.total_words,
  mece_category: $json.mece_category,
  geo_quadrant: $json.geo_quadrant,
  has_citations: $json.has_citations,
  brand_cited: $json.brand_cited,
  competitor_cited: $json.competitor_cited,
  raw_response_text: $json.raw_response_text || $json.raw_response,
  raw_response: $json.raw_response || $json.raw_response_text,
  run_duration_ms: $json.run_duration_ms,
  competitors: $json.competitors || [],
  citations: $json.citations || []
}) }}
